testcard_rows.candidate_family: Family C / holographic entanglement-wedge and code-subspace reconstruction
testcard_rows.primitive_objects: Boundary algebras, code-subspace states, entanglement wedges, logical bulk operators, and semiclassical bulk effective fields treated as reconstructible only inside a declared dictionary package.
testcard_rows.dynamical_rule: Boundary unitary evolution plus QEC/reconstruction consistency; bulk semiclassical dynamics may be read only where entropy, modular-flow, and operator-reconstruction constraints recover the same local equations.
testcard_rows.redundancy_quotient: Quotient by gauge redundancy, code-subspace representative choice, boundary reconstruction non-uniqueness, and dictionary choices that leave the same public boundary records invariant.
testcard_rows.coarse_graining_map: Large-N / semiclassical / finite-code-distance limit maps boundary records to bulk geometry through RT/HRT-like entropy, modular-flow, and entanglement-wedge reconstruction only inside a controlled validity domain.
testcard_rows.observer_public_record_map: Public proof artifacts, decoder/reconstruction benchmarks, boundary correlator or entropy identities, and replayable code/provenance records; no private dictionary intuition counts.
discriminator_observables: Finite-N reconstruction stability under the same boundary records and competing dictionary choices.
Uniform-versus-state-class sensitivity of the JLMS/recovery remainder under rare sectors, code-subspace growth, and changing semiclassical backgrounds.
Failure or survival of entanglement-wedge/logical-operator recovery outside the special AdS-like code-subspace package on a publicly replayable record.
testcard_rows.first_negative_control: A non-isomorphic dictionary or code-space overfit that reproduces the same benchmark records while changing the claimed bulk ontology.
testcard_rows.dominant_unpaid_debt: rev0378 closes the abstract whole-code criterion but exposes a stronger physical gap. Using REF-0736, the benchmark now measures operator-algebra recovery by the complementary-channel defect delta_A=||Nhat-Nhat o P_{A'}||_diamond, with delta_A^2/4<=E_A<=2 sqrt(delta_A). A target recovery error tau therefore needs delta_A<=tau^2/4. Under only the generic finite-dimensional lift, a state-only defect must satisfy epsilon_state<=tau^2/(4 d_code): at tau=0.1 and d_code=4096 the budget is 6.103515625e-7. A sharp transpose-dephasing channel control makes the unassisted state envelope fall to 4.88162069807176e-4 at d=4096 while the exact diamond defect is 0.999511837930193 and the minimum recovery error remains at least 0.249755978540648. An erasure-channel positive control verifies that a genuine complementary diamond defect can produce one common decoder with exact scaling. The unpaid debt is now source-specific: show that REF-0735 epsilon_OD/epsilon_sub-tr control the same complementary defect with an external reference, or supply a physical code/reference dimension and rate strong enough to pay the dimension lift, while retaining the existing channel, center/factor, backreaction, non-AdS, and observer-record obligations.
testcard_rows.next_kernel_work: Construct Delta=Nhat-Nhat o P_{A'} for REF-0735's fixed region and declared direct-sum algebra. Derive either a direct uniform diamond/cb bound with an external reference or an explicit state-to-diamond lift with physical d_code/reference growth; combine it on one domain with epsilon_OD, epsilon_sub-tr, approximate isometry, dominant-block decoders, center/factor modular geometry, and FLM/JLMS errors. Test the tau^2/(4 d_code) target inversion and the exponential rate condition c>s before comparing with the owned complementary-channel benchmark.

testcard_rows.owned_result_summary: rev0378 adds a reference-stable OAQEC completion. REF-0736 gives delta_A^2/4<=E_A<=2 sqrt(delta_A), so target error 0.1 requires delta_A<=0.0025; a generic d_code-dimensional state-to-diamond lift then requires epsilon_state<=0.0025/d_code. testcard_rows.candidate_family: Family C / learned, sparse, or route-specific inverse reconstruction
testcard_rows.primitive_objects: Public records, simulator outputs, sparse latent variables, learned inverse maps, and candidate-native recoverands separated from surrogate features.
testcard_rows.dynamical_rule: Train or fit an inverse only under declared simulator, prior, feature, regularization, and validation policies; treat the learned map as a candidate bridge only if it survives route-native holdout and countermodel tests.
testcard_rows.redundancy_quotient: Quotient by model architecture, regularization, latent-basis rotation, feature encoding, and policy choices that preserve predictive records but change inferred route variables.
testcard_rows.coarse_graining_map: Feature extraction and summary-statistic compression map high-dimensional records to recoverands, with OOD and sim-to-real fences preventing benchmark pass from becoming identity.
testcard_rows.observer_public_record_map: Versioned benchmark suites, held-out public records, model cards, training/provenance artifacts, and adversarial reruns that third parties can replay.
discriminator_observables: OOD reconstruction of a route-native invariant not present in the training summary statistics.
Order stability across architecture, seed, feature, and regularization choices.
Same-benchmark rival models that match prediction but disagree on candidate-native recoverands.
testcard_rows.first_negative_control: A learned surrogate that predicts the public benchmark while recovering a non-candidate latent variable or fails under a route-native OOD split.
testcard_rows.dominant_unpaid_debt: Recoverand-versus-surrogate debt: performance can remain high while the candidate-native variable is unidentified.
testcard_rows.next_kernel_work: Define one route-native recoverand whose failure cannot be hidden by predictive accuracy, then pair it with an adversarial public holdout and policy-choice stability test.

testcard_rows.dynamical_rule: Recover geometric equations from thermodynamic or information-theoretic stationarity/response relations, with equilibrium and near-equilibrium assumptions explicitly declared.
testcard_rows.redundancy_quotient: Quotient by horizon/observer choice, coarse thermodynamic variable reparameterization, equilibrium-slice selection, and entropy functional ambiguities.

testcard_rows.observer_public_record_map: Public derivations, relative-entropy proofs, semiclassical checks, horizon-thermodynamic identities, and non-equilibrium counterexample records.
discriminator_observables: Non-equilibrium horizon or local-causal-diamond response that cannot be absorbed into an arbitrary entropy functional.

A black-hole or cosmological record where thermodynamic primitives beat a many-microstructure comparator.
